title: Dakka Time
subtitle: Shooting phase: pick a shooter, aim yer guns, roll da dice

bullets: Click a unit (board or list) to make it da shooter, den point each gun at somefin'.
Pick a gun in da weapon list, den click da enemy — dat gun's now aimed. [b]All → <enemy>[/b] does every gun left in one go.
In a real game, if only ONE enemy is in range an' sight, da guns aim demselves — we switched dat off 'ere so ya get da practice.
[b]Confirm (N weapons)[/b] locks da targets in and opens da dice dock.
Guns fire top-to-bottom down da dock queue — [b]▲[/b] / [b]▼[/b] on da right of each row re-orders 'em before da first shot.
Each gun rolls to hit, den to wound, den da defender saves — kills from one gun are gone before da next fires.
[b]Fast Roll All ⏩[/b] rolls everyfin'; [b]Roll to Hit ▶[/b] goes step by step. [b]Done[/b] closes each save card.
[b]Complete Shooting[/b] finishes da unit — den pick da next shooter or end da phase.
Da [b]Dice Log[/b] tab on da left panel keeps every roll — check it when a result looks fishy.
[b]Shoot All Remaining[/b] auto-fires every unit ya ain't bothered aimin' yerself.

prompt.text: Da Boyz are out of da wagon an' da Witchseekers are in slugga range. In da Shooting phase every unit gets one go at blastin' — let's teach yer trigger fingers.

prompt.kbm: Click yer [b]Boyz[/b] mob — on da board or in da unit list on da right. Da weapon list on da right fills up wiv every gun dey've got, all sayin' [b](Click to Select)[/b] — nuffin's aimed yet.
prompt.pad: Tap {rb} till da [b]Boyz[/b] are da active shooter — {rb} cycles yer units, dat's da only control dat does. Da weapon list on da right shows every gun dey've got, none of 'em aimed yet.

hint.text: Da mob of ten south of da wagon. Da Warboss shoots wiv 'em — he's attached.

prompt.kbm: Time to aim. Click da [b]Slugga[/b] row in da weapon list on da right to pick dat gun, den click da [b]Witchseekers[/b] on da board. Da row swaps from [b](Click to Select)[/b] to [b]→ Witchseekers[/b] — dat's one gun aimed.
prompt.pad: Time to aim. {dpad} ▲▼ walks yer guns — stop on da [b]Slugga[/b]. {dpad} ◀▶ walks da enemy targets. Wiv da Slugga picked an' da Witchseekers highlighted, press {a} to aim it. Da row swaps to [b]→ Witchseekers[/b].

hint.text: Da Witchseekers are da only mob in range an' sight — every other row in da target list is greyed out for a reason.

prompt.kbm: Da Warboss is attached, so he's got guns too — an' any row still readin' [b](Click to Select)[/b] ain't firin'. Point da lot at da same mob: hit [b]All → Witchseekers[/b] under da weapon list, or click each row an' den da Witchseekers.
prompt.pad: Da Warboss is attached, so he's got guns too — any row still readin' [b](Click to Select)[/b] ain't firin'. {dpad} ▲▼ to da next gun, {a} to aim it at da Witchseekers, an' again till every row says [b]→ Witchseekers[/b].

hint.text: Aimin' a gun dat's already aimed at dat mob just tells ya so — it don't double up.

prompt.kbm: Every gun's pointed — now lock 'em in: click da glowin' [b]Confirm[/b] button on da right (it counts yer guns).
prompt.pad: Every gun's pointed — now lock 'em in: press {menu}, dat's [b]Confirm Targets[/b] on da pad. Want to re-aim first? {dpad} ◀▶ walks da targets, ▲▼ walks yer guns, {a} aims da current gun.

hint.text: Ya don't have to fire every gun — Confirm locks whatever's assigned.

prompt.kbm:
Da declarin' panel's gone an' da [b]WEAPON RESOLUTION[/b] dock's took its place on da right. Each row is one gun pointed at one mob, wiv da damage we reckon it'll do, an' dey fire [b]top to bottom[/b] — one gun goes all da way frough before da next one starts.
Every gun rolls da same three steps: [b]hit rolls[/b] against its Ballistic Skill, den [b]wound rolls[/b] (yer Strength against deir Toughness), den da defender makes [b]savin' throws[/b] an' whatever gets frough does damage an' takes models off.
[b]Da firin' order is yours to pick.[/b] Da [b]▲[/b] an' [b]▼[/b] buttons on da right-hand side of each row shove dat gun up or down da queue — only while it's still waitin', so sort it now. It matters: boyz killed by da first gun ain't dere to soak up da second.
When yer happy: [b]Fast Roll All ⏩[/b] rolls everyfin' at once, or [b]Roll to Hit ▶[/b] walks it step by step. Enemy saves pop up a results card — click [b]Done[/b] on each. When da big button says [b]Complete Shooting[/b], click it to finish da mob's go.
prompt.pad:
Dat's da [b]WEAPON RESOLUTION[/b] dock on da right. Each row is one gun pointed at one mob, an' dey fire [b]top to bottom[/b] — one gun all da way frough ([b]hit rolls[/b] on its Ballistic Skill, den [b]wound rolls[/b] Strength against Toughness, den da defender's [b]savin' throws[/b] an' da damage) before da next one starts.
[b]Da firin' order is yours to pick.[/b] Press {dpad} to walk da highlight up into da queue an' onto da [b]▲[/b] / [b]▼[/b] buttons on da right-hand side of each row, den {a} to shove dat gun up or down. Only works before da first shot — an' it matters: boyz killed by da first gun ain't dere to soak up da second.
Den {dpad} back down to [b]Fast Roll All ⏩[/b] an' press {a}, {a} on each [b]Done[/b] card, den {a} on [b]Complete Shooting[/b].

hint.text: Da 'Every step' dropdown picks how often da rollin' pauses. Stuck? Da big dock button always shows da next step.

prompt.kbm: Every one of dem rolls got written down. Click da [b]Dice Log[/b] tab on da panel down da left — hits, wounds an' saves, da lot of it.
prompt.pad: Every roll got written down. Glide {ls} onto da [b]Dice Log[/b] tab on da panel down da left an' press {a} — hits, wounds an' saves, da lot of it.

done.script:
var glp = tree.root.get_node_or_null("/root/Main/GameLogPanel")
return glp != null and str(glp.get_active_tab()) == "dice"

hint.text: Da tab's up top of da left panel, next to [b]Game Log[/b] — it's wearin' a ● 'cos dere's rolls ya ain't read yet.

steps.comment: This lived in T1 (Scoutin' da Field) between the datasheet steps, where it asked the player to open the Dice Log before anything had been rolled — an empty panel. It sits here instead: 'roll_da_dice' above it only completes once U_BOYZ_T.flags.has_shot is true, so by the time this step is up the shooting phase has written its hit/wound/save blocks into the shared dice log (see tests/scenarios/sp/dice_log_left_tab_shooting.json) and the tab is carrying its unread ● nudge.

prompt.kbm: Da wagon an' da grots could shoot too — ([b]Shoot All Remaining[/b] does 'em all in one go) — but we're savin' da ammo. Hit da big red button, check da phase summary, den [b]End Shooting Phase[/b].
prompt.pad: Da wagon an' grots could shoot too — we're savin' ammo. Press {menu}, den confirm [b]End Shooting Phase[/b] on da summary.

hint.text: Da summary counts yer hits an' casualties — Go Back if ya forgot someone.
